scope: Vale3.24.0 + same fixed single Microsoft.Passive rule, explicit config/no-global/plain stdin/JSON, no hosted CMS
method: Selected source sections at official tag commit2ee781716f8c177c2a143e18d535ddb11e264f00 reviewed. Thirteen source files indexed for reproducibility, not thirteen fully audited dependency closures. Prior official binary reused. Child-only environment removes all VALE_* variables; host variables unchanged. Effective config inspected and two synthetic calls repeated.

runs.text: The report was reviewed by the editor.

findings.finding: No positional args reads complete stdin into memory, then LintString. Errors go to stderr and exit2; outputs/errors are separate text paths.

Explicit config wins over VALE_CONFIG_PATH selection. --no-global prevents loading default global INI, but other environment paths remain possible. DefaultStylesPath consults VALE_STYLES_PATH; explicit local styles used in chosen profile.

Optional nonempty NLPEndpoint allows remote NLP. Text/lang appear in encoded URL query passed to HTTP POST, not just an opaque metadata request. Endpoint is empty in selected effective config. Empty endpoint takes local tagging fallback; non-English segmentation has its own endpoint condition. No full callgraph exclusion of every network function claimed.

startProfiling runs before flag parsing. VALE_CPUPROFILE and VALE_MEMPROFILE can create profile files. Child-only removal in new controlled runs excludes those environment-controlled paths. Profiles can contain operational metadata; exact prose content not established. Does not prove earlier PR5.91 inherited variables absent.
Selected existence rule matches block text, creates alerts and anchors. No text-submission operation seen in inspected rule runner.
Alerts including matched prose printed as JSON stdout; error-level alerts affect exit status, explaining suggestion exit0. Caller persistence remains explicit.

controlledResult: Effective NLPEndpoint empty; suggestion threshold and only selected Microsoft style section confirmed. Passive1 and manual active revision0. Previous eight-case results remain frozen.
privacyDecision: Stronger selected-path evidence, still research-only. Optional NLP/profiling paths prevent blanket whole-product no-network/no-write assertions. No OS traffic/write observation, full dependency audit, binary-source equivalence or deletion guarantee. No new graph qualification.
next: Consolidate distinct candidate evidence and remaining publication gates; no further automatic capture/tool expansion. Preserve unknowns as unknown rather than negative vendor findings.
